page_title: MAR 3-1 LOR | Marseille v Lorient 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Michael Murillo (Marseille) sees a yellow card from Bastien Dechepy after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' The game has begun to heat up. Laurent Abergel (Lorient) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+1' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle after Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Marseille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' Jean Onana (Marseille) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.

88' Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
87' The ball is cleared after Julien Ponceau (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lorient.
80' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Mohamed Bamba and he is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
78' It is time for a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is on for Pape Gueye.
78' Here's the change. Jordan Veretout leaves the pitch and Jean Onana (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
75' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Imran Louza will be replaced by Julien Ponceau (Lorient).
73' Pape Gueye (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
71' Substitution. Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) on for Samuel Gigot.
67' Marseille take a short corner kick.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing. Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
66' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' What a chance that is! Panos Katseris (Lorient) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
63' Faris Moumbagna goes off the pitch and Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) comes on.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Harit (Marseille) comes onto the pitch for Ismaila Sarr.
62' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Formose Mendy (Lorient) replacing Nathaniel Adjei.
62' Here is a change. Aiyegun Tosin is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
62' The referee signals a substitution. Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) is brought on as a substitute for Tiemoue Bakayoko.
61' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
60' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' 3 - 1 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yvon Mvogo into the bottom left corner.
54' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
53' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Marseille!

52' Play continues despite the shouts by some Marseille players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

51' Panos Katseris (Lorient) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. Panos Katseris (Lorient) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

46' Panos Katseris (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but Pau Lopez comes off his line to gather the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lorient will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Benjamin Mendy (Lorient), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:1.
41' 2 - 0 Goal! Samuel Gigot (Marseille) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
41' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes a short corner kick.

39' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.

36' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Michael Murillo finds Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Yvon Mvogo had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
33' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
29' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Imran Louza (Lorient), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

27' Panos Katseris (Lorient) anticipates the cross from Benjamin Mendy, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
26' The foul by Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Lorient will take a free kick near the side line.
25' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient). It's a free kick to Marseille, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' Bastien Dechepy blows the whistle, Michael Murillo (Marseille) is penalised for a foul. Lorient have a free kick.

20' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
17' The referee gives a yellow card to Julien Laporte (Lorient).

17' Julien Laporte (Lorient) brings his opponent down. Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a yellow card to Julien Laporte (Lorient). Marseille are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
15' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
14' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

13' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' A pass from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is intercepted by Pau Lopez and the move breaks down.

12' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
10' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
8' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
7' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. Marseille get a corner.
1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) meets a cross inside the box, but Yvon Mvogo wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Marseille will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Bastien Dechepy.
